title: Date-only helpers that work in every time zone
acceptanceCriteria: `isValidDateOnly` accepts only real calendar dates: `"2028-02-29"` passes; `"2026-02-30"`, `"2026-02-29"` and `"2026-13-01"` fail
`addDays` and `daysBetween` throw a `RangeError` for a date that doesn't exist, instead of rolling it over
`addDays` crosses month ends, year ends, leap days and daylight saving time changes: `addDays("2026-11-01", 1)` is `"2026-11-02"`
`daysBetween` counts calendar days, across daylight saving time changes too: `daysBetween("2026-03-07", "2026-03-09")` is `2`
`addDays` and `daysBetween` never read the machine's time zone (the grader runs them with local-time `Date` APIs disabled)
`isOverdue` is `false` during the due date itself and `true` from the next day
`isOverdue` decides what day it is in the user's `timeZone`: at 02:00 UTC on March 11, a March 10 task is overdue in Tokyo but not in New York
